metaTitle: About NisCorp AI — Company, capabilities, and approach
metaDescription: NisCorp AI builds practical AI, web apps, and operations software with clear proposals, fixed-scope sprints, and clean handover.

sections.heading: What we do
paragraphs: NisCorp AI designs and delivers modern web apps, enterprise operations software, and AI solutions such as RAG applications and internal assistants. The goal is simple: reduce manual work, make status clear, and leave you with a system that fits how your team already works.

steps.title: Discovery
steps.description: Discovery and scoping in plain language.

steps.title: Delivery sprints
steps.description: Fixed-scope sprints with weekly demos and measurable outcomes.

steps.title: Handover
steps.description: Production hardening, documentation, runbooks, and capability transfer so you are not dependent on a black box.

sections.heading: Capabilities
paragraphs: AI & LLM: RAG pipeline design, prompt design and evaluation, agentic workflows, guardrails; AWS Bedrock and OpenAI; OpenSearch vector search; Snowflake; LangChain/LangGraph; LangSmith.
Full-stack engineering: React/Next.js, Vue; Node.js/Express; REST/RPC; microservices; .NET MVC when needed.
Data & integration: Snowflake, Postgres, data modeling, event flows, dashboards with D3.js; integrations across CRM/ERP/analytics/identity.
Cloud & DevOps: AWS Serverless, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, automated testing, IaC-aligned workflows.
Delivery quality: Agile, code reviews, TDD (Jest/NUnit), release discipline.

sections.heading: Principles
paragraphs: Clarity over jargon; working software over slideware.
Build for maintainability and handover from day one.
Security and data responsibility: source-level access controls, PII handling, retrieval scoping, and opt-in data retention only.

sections.heading: Where we work
paragraphs: Remote-first with coverage across IST and US time zones; comfortable collaborating with distributed product, data, and operations teams.
